home.title: IoT FENSTER Partner Portal
home.description: B2B order management against a deferred purchase order. Log in with your partner account or register your company to request access.
home.badge: B2B portal for distributors and installers
home.f1Text: Products authorised for your company, with your price list and discount already applied.
home.f2Text: Confirm orders against your purchase order. No online payment: deferred invoicing.
home.f3Text: Order status at every step, a PDF summary and the shipment tracking link.

rechazar.title: Reject {partner}'s request?
rechazar.body: They will not be able to enter the platform. This is final from the panel: a rejected partner cannot be approved again.

suspender.title: Suspend {partner}?
suspender.body: Their users will stop being able to sign in and order immediately. Orders already confirmed are not affected and you can reactivate them at any time.

reactivar.title: Reactivate {partner}?
reactivar.body: Their users will be able to sign in and place orders again.

archivar.title: Archive {partner}?
archivar.body: It will disappear from the lists and its users will not be able to sign in. Its data and orders are kept, and you can unarchive it at any time. A company with unshipped orders cannot be archived.

desarchivar.title: Unarchive {partner}?
desarchivar.body: It will appear in the lists again and, if it was active, its users will be able to sign in again.

promocionar.title: Promote {partner} to Partner?
promocionar.body: They become a Partner (own sub-brand), normally because their purchase volume justifies it. It is recorded in the audit log with the units bought so far, and you can undo it.

degradar.title: Move {partner} back to Distributor?
degradar.body: They stop being a Partner and become a Distributor. Their data and orders do not change. It is recorded in the audit log.

quePuedoHacer.p: What can I do in the portal?
quePuedoHacer.r: Browse your brand catalog with your prices, prepare a cart, confirm orders and follow their status until shipping. There is no online payment: orders are handled with your purchase order number (PO Number).

noEntro.r: Check your email and password. If you have just registered your company, you cannot sign in until you verify your email and an IoT FENSTER administrator approves the registration; meanwhile you will see the same invalid credentials message.

olvidePassword.r: Click “Forgot your password?” under the form to receive a link to create a new one.

correoEmpresa.r: The corporate email of your company administrator. It must belong to the same domain you give as the website domain (for example, name@yourcompany.com if the domain is yourcompany.com).

despuesDeEnviar.p: What happens after I send the request?
despuesDeEnviar.r: You will verify your email and an IoT FENSTER administrator will review the request and set your terms (brand, price list and discount). Once approved, you can sign in with your email and password.

precioVisto.r: Your net price: the list RRP with your company discount already applied. Some products may have their own discount.

productoFalta.r: You only see the devices of the brand assigned to your company. If you need another one, ask your IoT FENSTER contact.

variantes.r: Each circle is a variant of the same model. Choose the one you want before adding it to the cart.

carritoGuardado.r: Yes. It stays saved in your account even if you sign out, until you confirm the order.

preciosCambian.r: The cart always shows today prices. If a price changes while you have it open, it is updated and, when you confirm, we warn you so you can review the new total.

poNumber.r: It is the number of your purchase order. It identifies this order both in your company and at IoT FENSTER.

comoSePaga.r: There is no online payment. When you confirm, the order is registered and handled with your purchase order.

editarDespues.p: Can I change the order after confirming it?
editarDespues.r: Not from the portal: when you confirm, prices and discounts are fixed. If you need a change, contact IoT FENSTER.

estados.r: Received: we have received it. Confirmed: IoT FENSTER has accepted it. In preparation: we are preparing it. Prepared: ready to go out. Shipped: it has left, with carrier and tracking link. Cancelled: it has been called off and you will see the reason.

encontrarPedido.p: How do I find an order?
encontrarPedido.r: Type the PED code, the PO Number or a product in the search box, and refine with the status and date filters. You can sort by date or by total.

descargarPdf.p: How do I download the order summary?
descargarPdf.r: Click “Download PDF” and choose the language of the document before downloading it.

repetirPedido.r: It adds the same lines to the cart at today prices and warns you about anything no longer available or with a changed price. It confirms nothing: you review the cart and confirm yourself.

precioFijo.p: Why does the price of an order not change?
precioFijo.r: When confirmed, the order keeps the RRP, discount and net price of that moment. They are not recalculated even if the price list changes later.

partnerODistribuidor.r: A partner is a distributor that buys more and has its own sub-brand (VBH, Procomsa, MySmartWindow). A distributor buys seeing the devices of its assigned brand; MySmartWindow by default.

aprobarSolicitud.p: How do I approve a request?
aprobarSolicitud.r: Open the “Pending approval” tab and click Approve: set the trade brand, price list and discount. The company receives the catalog of its brand and its users will be able to sign in.

suspenderArchivarEliminar.r: Suspending cuts access until you reactivate the company. Archiving hides it from the lists while keeping data and orders (not possible with unshipped orders). Deleting erases it completely and is only allowed if it has no orders.

datosPorCompletar.r: Companies loaded from a list carry provisional data (tax ID, domain or address “PENDIENTE”) until you complete their file.

descuentoEmpresa.r: The company discount applies to the list RRP of all its products. A product with its own discount uses that one instead of the general one.

productosDeMarca.r: Brand products come from the brand catalog and only allow discount and hide. Extras are assigned by hand and managed as usual.

cambiosAplican.p: What happens if I change something here?
cambiosAplican.r: Changes apply immediately to every company using that brand.

anadirLoQueFalta.p: What does “Add what is missing” do?
anadirLoQueFalta.r: It adds to the brand the base products it does not have yet, with a suggested name you can edit.

productoBase.r: The device itself. The same device is named differently depending on the brand (Connect-1, Wave-1, Icon1) but it is a single base product.

subirImagenes.r: Select one or several products and use “Upload image”. PNG, JPG or WebP up to 3 MB are accepted.

avanzarPedido.p: How do I move an order forward?
avanzarPedido.r: Only an administrator can change the status, one step at a time: Received, Confirmed, In preparation, Prepared and Shipped. When shipping, carrier, dispatch number and tracking link are requested.

cancelarPedido.p: How do I cancel an order?
cancelarPedido.r: It can be cancelled as long as it has not been shipped, giving a reason that the customer will see.

corregirEstado.r: The administrator can force a status skipping the sequence, for exceptional cases.

cifrasCanceladas.r: The invoiced total and the charts by company and by day do not include cancelled orders.

cambiarIdioma.p: How do I change the language?
cambiarIdioma.r: With the language selector in the top bar. It is remembered in your account.

miCuenta.p: Which account am I signed in with?
miCuenta.r: At the top right, above the bar, you see “Signed in as” with the email of the account in use.
